name: Westfield Topanga
description: Westfield Topanga is a premier shopping destination in Canoga Park offering world-class retail, dining, and entertainment experiences. The center features iconic global brands like Sephora, Zara, H&M, Uniqlo, and Adidas, along with exclusive events and seasonal experiences that bring communities together. With convenient amenities including Smart Parking and click-and-collect services, Westfield Topanga delivers both excitement and ease for shoppers seeking the latest fashion trends and entertainment.
demographics: Westfield Topanga primarily serves middle to upper-middle-income families and young professionals in the San Fernando Valley, with a diverse visitor base spanning ages 25-54. The trade area encompasses affluent neighborhoods in Woodland Hills, Calabasas, and Canoga Park, attracting shoppers seeking mainstream fashion brands and family-friendly entertainment options. Typical visitors are household shoppers with moderate to high disposable income who value convenience, variety, and a mix of national retailers and dining options in an accessible location.
